description: Repairs r-def-cursor-dao/prov-distinct-distinctrow-plain, prov-aggregate-groupby, prov-union-crosstab: an unconditional CancelUpdate followed Update and Errors was read once, so a stale 3020 from an earlier source showed even after a successful Update. For each source [SELECT DISTINCT N FROM T WHERE ID IN (4, 5) (edit N) ;; SELECT DISTINCTROW N FROM T WHERE ID IN (4, 5) (edit N) ;; SELECT N FROM T WHERE ID IN (4, 5) (edit N) ;; SELECT N, Count(*) AS Cn, Sum(ID) AS Si FROM T GROUP BY N (edit Cn) ;; SELECT N, Count(*) AS Cn, Sum(ID) AS Si FROM T GROUP BY N (edit N) ;; SELECT ID, N FROM T WHERE ID <= 3 UNION SELECT ID + 10, N FROM T WHERE ID > 6 (edit N) ;; TRANSFORM Count(ID) AS Cn SELECT S FROM T GROUP BY S PIVOT Fl (edit S)]: a marker failure (Database.Execute of 'DROP TABLE MarkerNoSuchTable') so that a stale entry can be recognised; BeginTrans; a dynaset over the source; Updatable and the per-field metadata (Name, Type, Size, Attributes, DataUpdatable, SourceTable, SourceField, Required, OrdinalPosition); Edit, Errors; assign the field, Errors; read the field; Update, Errors; EditMode; Requery and read every row; the recordset closed; Rollback. There is no CancelUpdate. Asks the updatability and edit target of DISTINCT, DISTINCTROW, aggregate, UNION and crosstab results, with the Number of each call that fails. The fixture copy is opened read-write.

args.text: SELECT DISTINCT N FROM T WHERE ID IN (4, 5)
SELECT DISTINCTROW N FROM T WHERE ID IN (4, 5)
SELECT N FROM T WHERE ID IN (4, 5)
SELECT N, Count(*) AS Cn, Sum(ID) AS Si FROM T GROUP BY N
SELECT N, Count(*) AS Cn, Sum(ID) AS Si FROM T GROUP BY N
SELECT ID, N FROM T WHERE ID <= 3 UNION SELECT ID + 10, N FROM T WHERE ID > 6
TRANSFORM Count(ID) AS Cn SELECT S FROM T GROUP BY S PIVOT Fl
